purpose: Freeze instrument identity, directional dangerous-misconception definitions, a two-case confirmatory assignment template, and one-sided Wilson gate mechanics before any pilot or confirmatory human response is collected.

semantic_amendment.prior_rule_retained: ParticipantCaseReady continues to require all six critical-domain items correct. It is a non-compensatory comprehension rule.
semantic_amendment.new_directional_rule: The confirmatory dangerous-error numerator includes only the registered unsafe response direction in an eligible analytical state. Conservative false-negative or uncertain responses remain comprehension errors but are not relabelled as false-green or another dangerous misconception.
semantic_amendment.reason: Any-error and dangerous-direction error answer different questions and must not share an undifferentiated numerator.
semantic_amendment.non_retroactivity: This prospective clarification does not alter prior synthetic scoring evidence or any future human data because none exist.

confirmatory_assignment_contract.unit: One private ConfirmatorySlotId, not a person identifier, contributes at most one primary observation to each dangerous-error domain.
confirmatory_assignment_contract.anchored_primary: Every slot receives pcm_interior_differential_hard_anchors. This case supplies the primary rounding, calibration-uncertainty, anchor-validity, and public-sharing cells.
confirmatory_assignment_contract.blocked_primary: Every slot receives exactly one of binary_conditional_support_boundary, rsm_structurally_disconnected, or invalid_missing_score_column in rotation. This case supplies false-green calibration and invented-Person-score cells.
confirmatory_assignment_contract.order: Anchored and blocked cases alternate first/second by slot within each language.
confirmatory_assignment_contract.language: English and Japanese schedules share role, blocked mechanism, and order codes.
confirmatory_assignment_contract.independence: Repeated responses within a slot are not treated as independent replicates; each domain uses its single registered primary case role.

instrument_identity_contract.canonicalization: Identity uses length-prefixed labelled byte components and canonical JSON for rule metadata.
instrument_identity_contract.version_rule: Any wording, option, correct answer, criticality, preview, directional rule, or layout-content change creates a new InstrumentContentSHA256 and InstrumentVersion.
instrument_identity_contract.pooling_rule: Different content identities may never be pooled as one instrument. Revision-specific results remain separate even if labels are similar.
instrument_identity_contract.freeze_rule: A confirmatory run must reference exactly one frozen version registered before its responses.

statistical_gate_contract.cells: Six directional dangerous-error domains separately within English and Japanese.
statistical_gate_contract.estimate: DangerousErrors / ValidEligibleSlots for the registered primary case role.
statistical_gate_contract.primary_interval: One-sided 95% Wilson upper confidence bound computed with z=Phi^-1(0.95).
statistical_gate_contract.primary_pass: Every cell must have ValidEligibleSlots >= a future prospectively registered minimum and WilsonUpper95 < 0.10 using strict inequality.
statistical_gate_contract.minimum_n: No default is supplied. The future confirmatory registration must set it before responses; the engine fails closed without it.
statistical_gate_contract.familywise_sensitivity: Also report a Bonferroni one-sided 1-0.05/12 Wilson upper bound for all 12 cells. This sensitivity does not replace or silently modify the registered primary rule.
statistical_gate_contract.invalid_records: Attempted, invalid/incomplete, valid, and eligible denominators are retained separately. Invalid records never count as correct and cannot be silently dropped from the audit ledger.
statistical_gate_contract.language_rule: No pooled-language pass and no language-equivalence claim.
statistical_gate_contract.rounding_rule: Bounds and proportions use integer counts and full binary64 computation; display rounding never determines pass/fail.
statistical_gate_contract.pilot_rule: The at-least-24-per-language pilot remains formative and cannot promote the UI. A zero-error n=24 cell is expected to miss the strict 0.10 primary bound, illustrating why pilot and confirmatory gates are separate.

planning_table_contract.interpretation: This is arithmetic, not a sample-size recommendation or power calculation. Attrition, recruitment, case balance, anticipated error rate, and design effects require a future protocol.

synthetic_validation.no_human_meaning: All response matrices are explicitly synthetic validator fixtures.
cases: zero dangerous errors at n=24 fails primary
zero dangerous errors at n=25 passes primary but not necessarily familywise sensitivity
one registered directional error changes only its item-language cell
a conservative wrong response counts as comprehension error but not a dangerous error
display_acceptable is dangerous while cannot_decide is incorrect but not dangerous
missing, duplicate, unknown-option, assignment-drift, mixed-version, and unregistered-version records fail closed
one failing cell blocks the overall gate
English success cannot compensate for Japanese failure

automated_success_gates.identity: Every parent hash matches before execution.
automated_success_gates.version: The frozen parent materials and preview manifest produce one reproducible content identity; content/rule mutation changes it and pooling is rejected.
automated_success_gates.direction: All six registered domains use only their eligible case role, correct option, and dangerous response codes; conservative errors are not mislabelled dangerous.
automated_success_gates.assignment: Candidate schedules contain two cases per slot, one observation per domain, alternating order, rotating blocked mechanisms, and language parity.
automated_success_gates.wilson: Independent formula checks, strict-boundary behavior, primary/familywise tables, and monotonicity pass at full precision.
automated_success_gates.synthetic: Every registered synthetic gate behavior matches, with attempted/invalid/valid denominators retained.
automated_success_gates.tests: New version/gate tests plus selected comprehension, operations, one-click, archive, and decision-stability tests pass.

interpretation_limits.coverage: Per-cell 95% bounds do not provide a simultaneous 95% familywise guarantee; the Bonferroni sensitivity exposes this distinction.
interpretation_limits.dependence: Wilson binomial bounds assume the registered one-primary-observation-per-slot construction; moderator/site clustering and other design effects require separate handling.
interpretation_limits.power: Passing arithmetic at a particular zero-error n is not adequate sample-size justification.
interpretation_limits.selection: Invalidity, attrition, nonresponse, recruitment, proficiency, device, and accessibility selection can bias observed error rates.
interpretation_limits.equivalence: Separate language passes do not establish Japanese-English equivalence.
